name: Intermediate shaft (camshaft chain drive)
variant_applicability: Every value below comes from 911 Carrera (993) documents. No local source states them for the M64/60 Turbo, so they are related comparison data, not M64/60 qualification.
name_correction: The BOM previously called this line 'Intermediate shaft gear / balance drive'. No local source mentions a balance shaft or balance drive; the sources below describe an intermediate shaft carrying the two camshaft-drive sprockets. 'Balance drive' is dropped as unsourced.

facts.statement: The intermediate shaft carries a drive sprocket for cylinders 1-3 and one for cylinders 4-6, aligned axially with the camshaft driven sprockets.

facts.source: catalog/manual/page-checked/993-workshop-manual-group15-cylinder-head.json (PDF p.177, page_checked); catalog/reference/m64-precision-20261025/facts.csv M64-PREC-O002 (specification booklet PDF29 / printed 52-53, factory_document_verified)
facts.limits: Construction distances only: no shaft drawing, journal diameter, bore spacing or hole pattern. Example dimension A is setup-dependent and is not recorded as an engine dimension.

facts.source: docs/993/993_MANUAL_DATA_MAP.md (row 'Intermediate shaft circumferential clearance, new', PDF p.137); catalog/manual/993-workshop-manual-measurements.json measurement_occurrences PDF p.137 lines 33-37
facts.limits: The measurement file marks these occurrences ocr_unreviewed; the data map assigns them to the intermediate shaft. A page check is still pending.
